verdict.rationale: Shopify's first-party pages say merchants can accept wallets alongside cards from day one, and they promote a 'one-click checkout,' which covers the platform one-click part of the story. The pack never names the specific wallets in the story or describes how saved buyer details avoid re-entry. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal support, documentation of how saved buyer details are reused, independent or hands-on corroboration.
